{{Quote|Every clone and their genetic makeup is property of the Kaminoan government.|[[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]]|<ref name="Conspiracy" />}}
The '''Ruling Council''',<ref name="Inside Worlds">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> also known as the '''Kaminoan government''',<ref name="Conspiracy" /> was the governing body of the planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The Ruling Council maintained administrative offices in the capital, [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], which was governed by [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]. Su was the head of the Kamino colony governors that comprised the Ruling Council.
